resource.title: 21-387 / 15-327 Monte Carlo Methods and Applications (Keenan Crane & Gautam Iyer, Carnegie Mellon University)
resource.covers: 课程主页（math.cmu.edu/~mcm-cmu，实际跳到 gi1242.codeberg.page/cmu-math-cs-mcm/）公开逐讲 notes（HTML/PDF 幻灯片）与每周作业、考试与解答。Schedule 逐条对应节点：Basic Monte Carlo Integration（bias/consistency、sample variance、convergence rate）、Convergence of Monte Carlo Integration（tail bounds、Chebyshev、弱大数律、特征函数）、Variance Reduction I（control variates、stratified sampling）、Variance Reduction II（importance sampling、quasi-Monte Carlo）、Numerics and Random Numbers（浮点、伪随机数质量）、Sample Generation（inversion、rejection、alias table）、Markov Chains（平稳分布、不可约、非周期、TV 收敛、mixing time、ergodicity）、MCMC Algorithms、Metropolis-Hastings（含 burn-in）、Langevin Monte Carlo / MALA、Simulated Annealing。正好覆盖随机抽样、方差缩减、重要性抽样、MCMC 与误差评估；与贝叶斯统计的交叉只到『用 MCMC 从后验采样』的应用层面。

courses.prereq_text: Students need a basic background in probability, multivariable calculus, and some coding experience in any language.

Topics include random number generators, variance reduction, Monte Carlo (including Markov Chain Monte Carlo) simulation, and numerical methods for stochastic differential equations. ... Recommended preparation: CSE 5A, CSE 8A, CSE 11, or ECE 15. Students should complete a computer programming course before enrolling in MATH 114. Prerequisites: MATH 180A.

extra_prereqs.evidence: CMU 21-387 课程介绍：'Students need a basic background in probability, multivariable calculus, and some coding experience in any language.'
CMU 21-387：'some coding experience in any language'（作业用 Python）；UCSD MATH 114：'Students should complete a computer programming course before enrolling'。

notes: 资源选 CMU 21-387：它是少见的本科向 Monte Carlo 专门课，notes 与 slides 全公开，MCMC、importance sampling、mixing time 逐讲都有，最贴合节点的 D2/D3 验收（抽样、标准误、链混合、方差缩减、遍历性）。注意 math.cmu.edu/~mcm-cmu 会重定向到 gi1242.codeberg.page/cmu-math-cs-mcm/（2024 版），两处内容一致。先修判定：M.6.1（概率论）supported —— CMU 明写 'basic background in probability'，UCSD MATH 114 明确 'Prerequisites: MATH 180A'（概率论）。额外的 M.1.4.1（多元微积分）与 P.1.1（程序设计）是原图没列但课程要求的。
